title: A frequency-domain method to inverse moving source problem with unknown radiating moment
summary: This paper introduces a multi-frequency factorization method for imaging a time-dependent source, specifically to recover its spatial support and the associated excitation instants. Using far-field data from two opposite directions, we establish a computational criterion that characterizes both the unknown pulse moments and the narrowest strip (perpendicular to the direction) enclosing the source support.
